name: IFCAMSC
recent: IFCAMSC 近期发布了 2025 年报，以及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日和 2025 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩。一名独立非执行董事在公开市场出售了少量股份。
notable: 独立非执行董事 Eng Kim Haw 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日出售 34,000 股普通股。
risks: 董事 Eng Kim Haw 在公开市场出售股份，持股比例下降 0.006%。

recent_en: IFCAMSC recently released its Annual Report 2025 and quarterly results for the periods ended 30 June 2026 and 30 September 2025. An Independent Non-Executive Director disposed of a small number of shares in the open market.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Eng Kim Haw disposed of 34,000 ordinary shares on 3 September 2026.
risks_en: Director Eng Kim Haw disposed of shares in the open market, reducing his shareholding by 0.006%.
